description: Isolation Forest 30-feature vector for unsupervised session-level behavioral anomaly detection.

if_encryption_starttls.description: 1.0 if encryption mode is STARTTLS or STLS

if_auth_before_tls.description: 1.0 if client authentication occurred before TLS establishment

if_pfs_present.description: 1.0 if cipher provides Perfect Forward Secrecy (DHE/ECDHE), 0.0 if not, NaN if unknown

if_tls_handshake_incomplete.description: 1.0 if TLS handshake was initiated but not completed, 0.0 if completed or plaintext

if_cert_visible.description: 1.0 if certificate data was observable in capture, 0.0 otherwise

if_cert_key_size.description: Public key size in bits (e.g. 2048, 4096), NaN if unobserved

if_cert_self_signed.description: 1.0 if certificate is self-signed, 0.0 otherwise, NaN if unobserved

if_cert_validity_days.description: Certificate validity window in days (valid_until - valid_from), NaN if unobserved

if_cert_key_algo_rsa.description: 1.0 if certificate key algorithm is RSA, NaN if unobserved

if_cert_key_algo_ec.description: 1.0 if certificate key algorithm is ECDSA/EC, NaN if unobserved

if_packet_count.description: Total number of TCP packets observed in the session

if_session_duration.description: Elapsed duration between first and last packet in seconds

if_client_packet_count.description: Number of packets originating from client

if_server_packet_count.description: Number of packets originating from server

if_packet_ratio.description: Ratio of client packets to total packets (0.0 - 1.0)

if_tcp_reset_count.description: Count of TCP RST flags observed in the session

if_session_complete.description: 1.0 if session capture is COMPLETE (clean SYN/FIN or full payload), 0.0 if PARTIAL

if_finding_count.description: Total number of deterministic findings associated with session

if_high_sev_count.description: Count of CRITICAL or HIGH severity findings (context only, not target label)

if_medium_sev_count.description: Count of MEDIUM severity findings (context only, not target label)

unknown_policy.description: UNKNOWN and NOT_OBSERVABLE values are represented as NaN in raw extraction. The fitted preprocessor imputes medians and scales via RobustScaler (IQR) before feeding to Isolation Forest.
unknown_policy.categorical_values: Explicit 0.0 / 1.0 flags or ordinal mapping with NaN for unobserved
unknown_policy.numerical_values: Actual observed values or NaN if unobserved; never defaulted to 0 at extraction stage
